TASK-TEST-LOAN.Call reserve twice with the same loan an:
import unittest
from equipment_catalog import EquipmentCatalog
from loan_service import LoanService

def _ok(res):
    return isinstance(res, dict) and res.get('ok') is True

def _err(res, code):
    return isinstance(res, dict) and res.get('ok') is False and res.get('error', {}).get('code') == code

class TestLoan(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.cat = EquipmentCatalog()
        self.svc = LoanService(self.cat)
        r1 = self.cat.register('CAM-1')
        assert _ok(r1)
        r2 = self.cat.register('CAM-2')
        assert _ok(r2)

    def test_reserve_idempotent_and_failures(self):
        res = self.svc.reserve('L1', 'CAM-1')
        self.assertTrue(_ok(res))
        self.assertEqual(res['data']['status'], 'RESERVED')
        res2 = self.svc.reserve('L1', 'CAM-1')
        self.assertTrue(_ok(res2))
        self.assertEqual(res2['data']['status'], 'RESERVED')
        conflict = self.svc.reserve('L1', 'CAM-2')
        self.assertTrue(_err(conflict, 'CONFLICT'))
        h = self.svc.history('CAM-2')
        self.assertTrue(_ok(h))
        self.assertEqual(len(h['data']), 0)
        unk = self.svc.reserve('L3', 'UNKNOWN')
        self.assertTrue(_err(unk, 'NOT_FOUND'))
        h1b = self.svc.history('CAM-1')
        self.assertEqual(len(h1b['data']), 1)
        rel = self.cat.release('CAM-1')
        self.assertTrue(_ok(rel))
        res_b = self.svc.reserve('L4', 'CAM-1')
        self.assertTrue(_ok(res_b))
        unavail = self.svc.reserve('L5', 'CAM-1')
        self.assertTrue(_err(unavail, 'UNAVAILABLE'))
        h1c = self.svc.history('CAM-1')
        self.assertEqual(len(h1c['data']), 2)

    def test_checkout_return_cancel(self):
        self.svc.reserve('L1', 'CAM-1')
        co = self.svc.checkout('L1')
        self.assertTrue(_ok(co))
        self.assertEqual(co['data']['status'], 'CHECKED_OUT')
        eq = self.cat.get_equipment('CAM-1')
        self.assertEqual(eq['data']['status'], 'UNAVAILABLE')
        ret = self.svc.return_equipment('L1')
        self.assertTrue(_ok(ret))
        self.assertEqual(ret['data']['status'], 'RETURNED')
        eq2 = self.cat.get_equipment('CAM-1')
        self.assertEqual(eq2['data']['status'], 'AVAILABLE')
        self.svc.reserve('L2', 'CAM-1')
        can = self.svc.cancel('L2')
        self.assertTrue(_ok(can))

            {'loan_id': 'L2', 'equipment_id': 'CAM-1', 'status': 'RETURNED'},
        ]
        original_len = len(records)
        original_first = dict(records[0])
        original_second = dict(records[1])
        report = LoanReport()
        report.summarize(records)

        self.assertEqual(records[0], original_first)
        self.assertEqual(records[1], original_second)
